properties.title: IFCB Daily Taxonomic Abundance — MVCO (WHOI)
properties.description: This item contains daily taxon-specific abundance estimates derived from the Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB) deployed at the Martha’s Vineyard Coastal Observatory (MVCO), processed from the WHOI IFCB Data Archive. Daily summaries are generated by aggregating per-bin classification outputs over each calendar day and converting to taxon-specific object concentrations (objects/mL) using a winner-takes-all approach. Included fields typically include day, latitude/longitude, instrument identifier, analyzed volume, classification threshold, and object concentration by class.
